title: D5 node auto-join without auto-authorization (N7)
objective: A node with only Python, git and a data-plane credential joins and drains synthetic epochs; joining grants no authority: the node runs only approved code (ancestor of origin/main), creates no chains, and cannot validate or clear contests.
problem: Today every ubu node is provisioned by hand, and node tokens can push to Prometheus main, so 'a push grants no authority' is convention, not structure.
non_goals: changing the existing PrometheusWorker service or its tokens (EP-GLOBAL's)
evidence_required: a join test (hermetic) and a join on one ubu node
refusal tests: unapproved code, chain creation, validation writes

acceptance.condition: passes; one ubu node joins and drains epochs
